timing: Added during engineering pilot development, before a successful pilot and before any complete 22-hull analysis. Earlier failed proof-generation runs remain separate. This is not a blind or external preregistration.
additional_question: Can exact dual polynomial witnesses certify globally minimum worst-case response sensitivity among all polynomial-reproducing linear estimators, and how does that compare with least squares on held-out physical measurements?
candidate_search: Enumerate all supports of size degree+1 among the seven training abscissas; solve exact interpolation equations; minimize sum of absolute weights; require a separate bounded dual polynomial that certifies global optimality. Search completeness is not trusted.
comparisons: For every declared held-out and extrapolation query, report least-squares and minimax gains; report held-out SSE of both estimators. Include every degree and hull, regardless of outcome.
bound_scope: Worst-case bound over all coordinatewise bounded response perturbations, conditional on exact predictor values and the declared polynomial model. No stochastic coverage or physical model acceptance.
